geometry.classification: Virtual uniform1D100cm3 chain, sealed left end and externally contacted right terminal control volume. Immobile pure solids and rigid cells; no measured brick shape or pores.

transport.classification: Explicit virtual continuum coefficients. Face conductance/mobility scales as area over center distance; neither inferred nor measured brick transport.

initial_mapping: Divide the qualified capsule elemental inventories and total volume equally; same uniform initial temperature and full external conductance/mobilities/radiative port. One cell must match the already qualified capsule. Internal faces scale conductance and mobility as area/center distance.
external_contact_definition: Gas/thermal film and ideal black radiative port couple directly to the terminal control-volume temperature and potentials. No extra surface storage, half-cell resistance or hidden massless-surface solve. This is the declared discrete approximation; spatial convergence must be shown separately before a continuum claim.

numerics.inventory_absolute_tolerance_basis: Whole-capsule original absolute tolerance divided by actual cell count; ledger and temperature tolerances unchanged.

scope: Develop and qualify one/two cells before finer grids. Source-defined positive inventory equilibrium and caloric-only tangent; do not use unqualified analytic gas-potential inventory Jacobians. No real material, finite kinetics, deformation or full brick cycle qualification.
